construction_conventions: C(r,z0,z1,x,y): solid cylinder radius r, axis +Z at (x,y), from z0 through z1; omit x,y for (0,0). K(r0,r1,z0,z1,x,y): coaxial cone frustum bottom/top radii r0/r1.
B(x0,x1,y0,y1,z0,z1): axis-aligned closed box. RB(a,u0,u1,v0,v1,z0,z1): B(u0,u1,v0,v1,z0,z1) rotated +a about Z. XY(r,a)=(r cos a,r sin a).

All union, subtraction, intersection, rotation and fillet operations are ordered; the subordinate constructions are built independently before insertion. Only the explicitly identified fillets occur in f13_jog.py. The source is nominal construction authority; text and diagrams are not evidence of BRep equivalence.

Top C-groove is ruled loft of the two exact planar profiles below at Z35.6 and Z36.4, subtracted from platter. No generic offset approximation: use the following arc-centre construction.
For profile offset d=0 at Z35.6, d=0.8 at Z36.4: O=19.2+d; I=16.8-d; xc=2.8; yo=sqrt(18.4^2-xc^2); yi=sqrt(17.6^2-xc^2). OL=(-xc,yo), OR=(xc,yo), IL=(-xc,yi), IR=(xc,yi). rad(P,r)=P*r/|P|.

Boundary in order: CCW arc centre (0,0) rad(OL,O) to rad(OR,O); CCW arc centre OR to (2-d,yo); line to (2-d,yi); CCW arc centre IR to rad(IR,I); clockwise arc centre (0,0) to rad(IL,I); CCW arc centre IL to (-2+d,yi); line to (-2+d,yo); CCW arc centre OL to rad(OL,O). Arc sweep is modulo 360 in indicated direction. Each arc radius is distance from its centre to its start. All four arc destinations are explicitly listed in the original sequence: arc OR ends at right_up=(2-d,yo); arc IR starts at right_low=(2-d,yi) and ends at rad(IR,I); arc IL starts at rad(IL,I) and ends at left_low=(-2+d,yi); arc OL starts at left_up=(-2+d,yo) and ends at rad(OL,O). The first centre-O arc is the long CCW arc, not the short arc across the opening.

t30: Exact nominal source ridge before trim: radial offset d=0 for male and d=0.05 for female cutting tool. root=14.725+d; crest=14.975+d; h=0.03125+0.25/sqrt(3). Ordered (radius, axial offset) vertices: (root-0.025,-h), (root,-h), (crest,-0.03125), (crest,+0.03125), (root,+h), (root-0.025,+h).

For every vertex construct RH helix of pitch 0.5, axial height 3.5, start (r,0,2.5+axial offset), around +Z. Join corresponding adjacent helices, including last to first, by ruled faces; cap both ends at Z offset 0 and 3.5 with polygonal faces; form closed solid and intersect with C(16,3,5.5).

The common ridge centre phase is Zc=2.5+0.5*(theta/360+n), n integer, for unwrapped theta on the +Z right-handed helix; +X at Z=2.5 is the start, and at theta=180 degrees ridge centres occur Z=2.75+0.5n. Wrap t=Z-2.5-0.5*theta/360 to [-0.25,0.25); ideal profile crest |t|<=0.03125 and root at |t|=h=0.03125+0.25/sqrt(3) (~0.1755875673). This is an ideal interior analytic interpretation, not proof of ruled surface parameterization, finite ends or boolean output. Female tool offset is +0.05 radial and both collars use the identical absolute phase; no ISO fit is implied.
